items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Black in San Diego was a piano player. And when that piano was organized, I didn't know who played with it.

ctx.x: What about the St. Peter's band with Arnold De Pass? Yeah. I never did hear anything about that band. Could you tell me something about that band? Well in that band. The first band was Arnold. I know of the hit of the band.

It was his band. It was Elvin Coward. It was Benny Pinnum. It was bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo…
Would you say you were in demand? Would you say you were in demand? Well, I was, I was a young man.
